# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 戶樀也。从木啻聲。《爾雅》曰：“檐謂之樀。”讀若滴。
舂# pound + 木 tree/wood → pound a wooden *stake* in the ground.
橛杙也。从木舂聲。

A depiction of an oak tree with acorns (ground into powder via a lengthy grinding process). *Music* and *enjoyment* are onomatopoeic, borrowed meanings, the pronunciation of the character simulating the din of a crowd → *play* (an instrument); *amuse oneself*; *pleasant*; *fun*; *happy*; *delightful*; *comfort*; *easy*.
五聲八音緫名。象鼓鞞。木，虡也。
從 here an abbreviated form# of 縱 vertical + 木 tree/wood → *fir* (← tree species that can reach over 70-80 meters in height).
松葉柏身。从木從聲。
棥# pen; fence; enclosure + 大 great → large and rough-woven *pen/fence*; *hedge*; *enclosure*; *(bird)cage*.
鷙不行也。从𠬜从棥，棥亦聲。
As per 婁# (continuum) + 木 tree/wood → wooden structure of multiple stories → *tower*; *lookout*.
重屋也。从木婁聲。
巣# nest (→ shape indicator) + 木 tree/wood → scoop fish with a nest-shaped wooden implement → *scoop fish with a net*; *net for scooping fish*. *Eradicate* and *bring to an end* are borrowed meanings.
澤中守艸樓。从木巢聲。
樸樕，木。从木欶聲。
木也。以其皮裹松脂。从木雩聲。讀若華。
衺柱也。从木堂聲。
As per 票# (rise) + 木 tree/wood → raised, wooden *sign* → *mark*.
木杪末也。从木𤐫聲。

As per 翏# (separate from a main unit) + 木 tree/wood → branch separating from others in bending/drooping (compare 朽) → *bending/drooping branch*. *Undulate to make forward progress* is a borrowed meaning (compare 蜷 and 蜿).
下句曰樛。从木翏聲。
木。出發鳩山。从木庶聲。
果似棃而酢。从木虘聲。
As per 區# (curve/bend) + 木 tree/wood → cylindrical *pivot* (bending in) penetrating the shaft of a door.
戶樞也。从木區聲。
As per 章# (rise) + 木 tree/wood → high-rising *camphor laurel tree*.
松心木。从木㒼聲。
As per 莫# (concealed) + 木 tree/wood → wooden *mold* concealed by clay covering it → *copy*; *imitation*; *shape*; *model*.
法也。从木莫聲。讀若嫫母之嫫。

The right-hand element# is as per 永 (water stretching far into the distance) + 羊 (abundant) → waterway delivering abundant supplies. In 樣, which adds 木 tree/wood, this element suggests a tree (a horse-chestnut or oak) that supplies abundant nuts. 橡 also referred to this tree, and 樣 came to borrow, then extend upon, the "shape/image" meanings of the 象 element of 橡 → *manner*; *condition* → *model*; *pattern*; *fashion*; *method*. *Mr./Mrs./Miss/Ms.* is a borrowed usage, deriving from the old Japanese term そおも → さま, meaning "over there."
As per 黃# (extend) + 木 tree/wood → bars extending at length → *side*; *horizontal* → *width*; *breadth*; *woof* (thread); *lie/lay down*.
闌木也。从木黃聲。
木 tree/wood + 堅 hard → *oak* (← hard-wooded tree).
As per 貳# as described in 弐 (aligned) + 木 tree/wood → aligned thorns of a thorned *jujube* (tree). Compare 棗.
酸棗也。从木貳聲。
弋也。从木戠聲。
焦# scorch + 木 tree/wood → scorched *firewood* → *cut wood* (for a fire); *woodcutter*.
𢿱也。从木焦聲。
As per 菐# as described in 僕 (rough) + 木 tree/wood → rough, *unprocessed lumber* → *simple*; *natural*; *plain*.
木素也。从木菐聲。

樸.explanation: 樸 represents simple/plain/unadorned; 朴 may remain unchanged in surnames and other distinct lexical senses.
樸.example: 朴素 → 樸素; 姓朴 → 姓朴
樸.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 尌# is 寸 hand/action indicator + 壴 as described in 鼓 (round drum set on a stand) → set/stand a drum in place → set/stand in place. 樹 adds 木 tree/wood → stand up a sapling in planting it → *set up*; *tree*; *plant* (v.).
生植之緫名。从木尌聲。
華# brilliant; gorgeous + 木 tree/wood → tree with gorgeous branches and foliage → (variety of) *birch*.
椐也。从木貴聲。
尊# cask + 木 tree/wood → *cask*, *barrel*, *keg* or *wooden container*.
越# go over/beyond + 木 tree/wood → *shade* provided by overhanging trees → *line of trees overhanging a road*.
As per 單# (rattan weapon) + 木 tree/wood → a *boxwood* (← tree the flat, thin leaves of which resemble the rattan weapon represented by 單).
木也。可以爲櫛。从木單聲。
杶也。从木筍聲。
海中大船。从木發聲。
As per 毳# (dense growth) + 木 tree/wood → wooden transport vehicle used in thick marshland → *sleigh*; *sled*. For these meanings, compare the Made-in-Japan characters 艝 and 轌.

As per 堯# (arch/rise high) + 木 tree/wood → tall, *bent/twisted piece of wood* (compare 柔) → *bend*; *twist*; *weaken* (and ruin). Also, by interpreting the character as a piece of wood raised high, *oar* and *paddle*.
曲木。从木堯聲。
喬# tall and limber + 木 tree/wood → arching, wooden *bridge*.
水梁也。从木喬聲。
大木皃。从木閒聲。
木也。从木番聲。讀若樊。

The element minus 束 originally combined 石 (substantial) + 囗 circular enclosure → substantial goods contained in an enclosure. The addition of 束 bundle to an abbreviated form# of this element suggests the substantial contents of a *sack*, open at both ends, placed horizontally in a wooden frame. The character also conveys a minor meaning of *bellows*.
囊也。从㯻省，石聲。
椽也。从木𤋯聲。
As per 矞# (circular) + 木 tree/wood → tree bearing round *citrus fruit*. たちばな (Citrus tachibana) is not the mandarin orange, but an inedible variety of citrus fruit native to Japan.
果。出江南。从木矞聲。
登# rise + 木 tree/wood → stepladder; stool. *(Bitter) orange* is a borrowed meaning.
橘屬。从木登聲。
長木皃。从木肅聲。
弋也。从木厥聲。一曰門梱也。
屋梠前也。从木覃聲。一曰蠶槌。
木也。从木惠聲。

幾# minute + 木 tree/wood → wooden *device* such as a *loom* in which cogs and other moving parts come into minute contact → *machine* → *opportunity* (← interplay of circumstances that create a new opportunity).
主發謂之機。从木幾聲。

象# elephant (→ large object) + 木 tree/wood → a large tree, the nuts and bark of which were a staple food and dyeing product, respectively, in certain parts of China → *horse chestnut*. For (Japanese) horse chestnut, compare the Made-in-Japan character 栃.
As per 隋# (collapsing pile) + 木 tree/wood → warped, elliptical wooden frame → *oval*.
車笭中橢橢器也。从木隋聲。
As per 童# (run through) + 木 tree/wood → wooden *pole* used in thrusting attacks → *thrust*. A *tree* the flowers of which were woven into cloth is a borrowed meaning.
帳極也。从木童聲。
As per 曾# (pile) + 木 tree/wood → wood piled to create a platform serving as a primitive *dwelling*. Compare 巣.
酸小棗。从木然聲。一曰染也。
車轂中空也。从木喿聲。讀若藪。
As per 畺# (tight; taut) + 木 tree/wood → variety of *oak* the bark of which is tightly demarcated.
枋也。从木畺聲。一曰鉏柄名。
As per 亶# (long and flat) + 木 tree/wood → flat piece of fragrant wood (shaved for incense) → *sandalwood*.
木也。从木亶聲。
As per 敫# as described in 激 (collide and scatter) + 木 tree/wood → a call to scatter an enemy, inscribed on wood → *manifesto*.
二尺書。从木敫聲。
木也。从木煔聲。
以木有所擣也。从木雋聲。《春秋傳》曰：“越敗吳於檇李。”
圜案也。从木瞏聲。
河柳也。从木聖聲。
As per 意# (contained in the heart) + 木 tree/wood → *ilex* (holly), a flowering plant in which small birds take refuge. Compare 柊.
杶也。从木意聲。
禽# capture + 木 tree/wood → harvest tree fruit with a net. The compound 林檎 refers to an apple.
As per 詹# (bear a burden) + 木 tree/wood → a roof bearing/encompassing eaves (compare 簷) → *brim*; *rim*. *Bear/carry* (on the shoulders) is a borrowed meaning.
㮰也。从木詹聲。
繘耑木也。从木毄聲。
As per 辟# (spread) + 木 tree/wood → *Amur cork tree* with expansive branches.
黃木也。从木辟聲。
As per 會# (reduce/eliminate space) + 木 tree/wood → the tight spiral shape of the cone of a Chinese juniper → variety of *cypress*; *Japanese cypress*.
柏葉松身。从木會聲。
As per 解# (protective element) + 木 tree/wood → *pine resin* (← protective coating). (Variety of) *oak* is a borrowed meaning in Japan, via confusion with 槲.
楸也。从木賈聲。《春秋傳》曰：“樹六檟於蒲圃。”
As per 敬# (stiff; upright) + 木 tree/wood → *tool*/frame for straightening a bow (by pulling tightly on both ends).
As per 僉# (assemble) + 木 tree/wood → sort through/*check* an assemblage of wooden tablets → *inspect*; *investigate* → *seal* (← stamp a seal on tablets that have been inspected) → *regulate*.
書署也。从木僉聲。
An abbreviated form# of 牆 (extend) + 木 tree/wood → *mast*. The connection with boats is more evident in the variant form 艢, which substitutes 舟 boat for 木.
As per 義# (ceremony) + 木 tree/wood → ceremony performed in equipping a (wooden) boat → *equip*; *prepare to launch*. Compare 艤.
榦也。从木義聲。
壽# (long and curved) + 木 tree/wood → long, curving piece of wood → *block of wood* → *blockhead*; *foolish*; *ignorant*. *Stump* is a borrowed meaning.
斷木也。从木𠷎聲。《春秋傳》曰：“𣚑柮。”

entries.text: 枸杞也。从木，繼省聲。一曰監木也。
絡絲檷。从木爾聲。讀若柅。
木檹施。从木旖聲。賈侍中說，檹卽椅木，可作琴。
監# keep watch over + 木 tree/wood → wooden enclosure to contain and keep watch over prisoners or animals (compare 狎) → *cage*; *pen*. *Handrail* and *railing* are borrowed meanings.
櫳也。从木監聲。一曰圈。
棼也。从木㥯聲。
枲屬。从𣏟，熒省。《詩》曰：“衣錦檾衣。”
山桑也。从木厭聲。《詩》曰：“其檿其柘。”
As per 翟# (rise high) + 木 tree/wood → raise an *oar* (compare 棹) in paddling/rowing → *paddle*; *row* (a boat).
所以進舩也。从木翟聲。或从卓。《史記》通用濯。
As per 匱# (empty container) + 木 tree/wood → wooden container → *chest*; *coffer*; (wooden) *tub*.
木也。可以爲大車軸。从木齊聲。
摩田器。从木憂聲。《論語》曰：“櫌而不輟。”
柎也。从木質聲。
所以几器。从木廣聲。一曰帷屏風之屬。
龜目酒尊，刻木作雲雷象。象施不窮也。从木畾聲。

As per 魯# (long and drawn out) + 木 tree/wood → a *scull* (single oar of a boat, drawn up out of the water and moved from one side to the other to propel the vessel) → *oar*. Compare 艪. *Watchtower* and *turret* are via reinterpretation of the character as a high (= vertically long) wooden construction.
大盾也。从木魯聲。
As per 節# (be in proximate alignment) + 木 tree/wood → *comb* (with evenly spaced teeth; compare 梳) → *line up tightly*.
梳比之總名也。从木節聲。
車上大橐。从㯻省，咎聲。《詩》曰：“載櫜弓矢。”
As per 𧶠# as described in 續 (pass along) + 木 tree/wood → *container* with drawers passing along rails → *box*; *cabinet*.
匱也。从木賣聲。一曰木名。又曰：大梡也。
As per 縁# (pendent/drooping) + 木 tree/wood → tree producing fruit in large quantities, the weight of which causes its branches to droop. 枸櫞 specifies a lemon tree (Citrus limon).
As per 樂# (oak tree) + 木 tree/wood → (variety of) *oak*. 櫟 was devised to replace 樂 after the latter was borrowed to convey its present meanings.
木也。从木樂聲。
斫謂之櫡。从木箸聲。

As per 盧# (sunken) + 木 tree/wood → piece of wood that sinks into a pillar under the weight of the roof the wood supports → *supporting block*; (column) *capital*. *Sumac* and *Japanese wax tree* are borrowed meanings.
柱上柎也。从木盧聲。伊尹曰：“果之美者，箕山之東，青鳧之所，有櫨橘焉。夏孰也。”一曰宅櫨木，出弘農山也。

As per 歷# (neat lines) + 木 tree/wood → stable/manger constructed of neatly aligned pieces of wood. Also, via the idea of neatly aligned pieces of wood, a *trough* for feeding livestock. (Certain variety of) *oak* is a borrowed meaning.
櫪㯕，椑指也。从木歴聲。
棺也。从木親聲。《春秋傳》曰：“士輿櫬。”

The left-hand element of 辥 combines 屮 grass shoot + 𠂤 as described in 追 (tall pile of objects) → compressed bundles of cut grass/vegetation (compare 乂). 辥# adds 辛 needle/cutting implement → cut grass/vegetation. 櫱 further adds 木 tree/wood → *offshoot* growing from the *stump* of a cut tree.
As per 龍# (winding) + 木 tree/wood → (circular) wooden *cage* (compare 籠). A variant form, 槞, employs the 竜 form of 龍.
檻也。从木龍聲。
As per 霝# (linked) + 木 tree/wood → *latticework* → *lattice window*.
楯閒子也。从木霝聲。
嬰# extend about + 木 tree/wood → flowering blossoms extending about a tree (compare 榮) → variety of plum tree → *cherry tree*; *red*; *pink*.
果也。从木嬰聲。
楔也。从木韱聲。
崐崘河隅之長木也。从木繇聲。
